title: Exposing Vulnerability Monoculture Through Systemic Adversarial Robustness
abstract: arXiv:2610.27353v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Beneath the apparent diversity of foundation models lies an increasingly homogeneous technical stack of common training pipelines, distillation methods, and data. These shared algorithmic choices can expose an otherwise distinct model ecosystem to concentrated risks leading to a vulnerability monoculture. Yet current practice in assessing adversarial robustness is restricted to individual robustness scores and attack transfer rates, leaving open the unexplored fundamental question: how many attacks suffice for catastrophic widespread compromise? In this paper, we investigate the empirical nature of shared vulnerabilities within a model pool and introduce Systemic Adversarial Robustness (SAR), a novel measure of shared vulnerability of a model pool through the attack diversity needed to exploit it. translated_title: 通过系统性对抗鲁棒性揭示“漏洞单一化”现象
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.27353v1 公告类型：cross。摘要：在基础模型表面上呈现的多样性之下，实际上隐藏着日益同质化的技术栈——包括通用的训练流程、蒸馏方法和数据。这些共享的算法选择可能使原本彼此不同的模型生态系统面临集中化的风险，从而导致“漏洞单一化”。然而，当前评估对抗鲁棒性的实践仅限于单个模型的鲁棒性分数和攻击迁移率，留下了一个未被探索的根本性问题：多少次攻击足以造成灾难性的大范围模型失陷？在本文中，我们研究了模型池中共享漏洞的经验性质，并提出了系统性对抗鲁棒性——这是一种通过攻陷整个模型池所需的攻击多样性来衡量模型池共享漏洞程度的新颖指标。具体而言，SAR在单一攻击的可迁移性与各模型独立鲁棒性这两个极端之间进行插值：较小的值揭示了漏洞单一化……
tldr: 该论文提出“系统性对抗鲁棒性”这一新指标，通过攻陷一个模型池所需的攻击多样性来量化基础模型之间的共享漏洞，揭示了因训练技术栈同质化而导致的“漏洞单一化”集中风险。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Systemic Adversarial Robustness (SAR), a novel metric that quantifies shared vulnerabilities across a pool of foundation models via the attack diversity needed to compromise them, exposing the concentrated risks of a vulnerability monoculture arising from homogeneous technical stacks.
